settings.text:
We are committed to growing with our partners by providing the best matting solution, highest quality and the fastest delivery to the end-user customer. This commitment is the reason why we are by far the #1 Mat Company in the Indian Sub-Continent.

Backed with a strong national network and a large reseller base internationally, our diversified operations are seamlessly integrated right from product manufacturing to organized retail to providing high quality end-customer service.

Our high business ethics, reliability of our products and services and respect for people have contributed towards building our good corporate image in the industry.

Join Us

Embark upon an enriching journey to build your career with us. At Ultimats, we believe in fostering a culture of growth, learning and innovation, where your talents can flourish and make a meaningful impact.

Joining our team means being part of a dynamic community that values diversity, collaboration, and continuous development. Whether you're just starting your career or looking to take the next step, we offer a range of exciting opportunities across various departments and disciplines.

Come, be a part of our mission and let's shape the future together and create value.

Job responsibilities: - Ensure presence of Ultimats Brand in each segment such as Hotels / Hospitals/ Institutions, etc. in your area of operation. - Prospect & identify opportunities and convert them into business. - Maintain and enhance relationship with customers by providing support, information and guidance. - Visit existing customers to strengthen relationship.
